name: rate-limit
description: Distributed request limiting by authenticated user, validated API key, or trusted-proxy client address. Uses Redis across API replicas and returns stable 429/503 errors.
env: # rate limit (window in seconds, max requests per identity)
# higher ceiling for SSR runtime settings reads (maintenance, sign-up, branding)
# trust no proxy hop by default; set the exact production proxy depth
instructions: Ensure Redis is running:  docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
Tune the general, authentication, and runtime limits in .env.
Set RATE_LIMIT_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS to the exact number of trusted reverse proxies; keep 0 for direct API access.
Authenticated users and validated X-API-Key clients receive independent opaque counters; other traffic uses the trusted client address.
Exceeded limits return RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with HTTP 429 and Retry-After. Redis failures return RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE with HTTP 503.
Provide RateLimitIdentityExtension from app.extensions.ts when an application has another validated machine-key source; keep the single managed RateLimitModule import.
GET /health and GET /health/ready bypass request quotas so orchestrator probes remain reliable.
The limit is shared across API replicas because it is stored in Redis.
